'''Netro''' was a [[Ganathan]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who worked on repairs of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] on the orders of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Empatojayos Brand]].
